title: Approximate virtual quantum broadcasting
summary: The no-broadcasting theorem, a fundamental limitation on the communication of quantum information, holds that a physical process cannot broadcast copies of an unknown quantum state to two or more receivers. Recent work has explored ways of circumventing this limitation using "virtual" implementations of non-physical processes using measurement and data-processing on statistical samples of the unknown input.
